lastCompletedStory.title: Add clampDashboardWidth helper with unit tests

nextStoryContext: clampDashboardWidth(windowWidth) is exported from src/tmux/session.ts. Formula: Math.min(52, Math.max(34, Math.round(windowWidth * 0.20))). US-002 must replace the hardcoded '-l', '36' in ensureProjectSession's dashSplitResult split-window call with String(clampDashboardWidth(220)) = '44'. The existing test 'split-window for dashboard uses -l 36 right pane' (test/tmux-session.test.ts line ~274) must be updated to assert '44' instead of '36'.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure arithmetic helper using Math.round/min/max (JS built-ins). No external library touched.
